The total rule tiles every finite pattern, and the public set itself includes a 2x2 diagonal pair and a 2x2 three-cell solid-L pattern. The detector sometimes treats a nonzero modal color as background and zero as foreground, so its short_line/solid_2x2 probes can satisfy the exact square, palette, background, and rounded 35-75% clean grammar. Singleton, all-background, monochrome, out-of-density, nonsquare, ragged, and foreign-palette cases are rejected; accepting the remaining compact patterns is not a defect.; The strict complete-profile rate is 11.98-14.92% across six independent cells: above the 12% explicit prior in some cells because general single-color random masks can lawfully fall into a public D4/torus orbit.; Side-2 ordinary random draws are intentionally omitted to avoid the finite-space collapse; every band still gets both complete side-2 public profiles through the calibrated profile prior and explicit side overrides support the full domain.; Multicolor tiles are valid for the total cellwise oracle but not part of the seven public morphologies. rationale: VERSION 1.2.0 -> 2.0.0: replaced texture-library postprocessing with a constructive tile sampler whose returned side and foreground palette size exactly equal the two declared axes.; Added a calibrated default-only prior over all seven complete public binary morphologies. D4 transforms, toroidal row/column shifts, and foreground-color relabeling are exact tiling metamorphisms.; Restored the demonstrated single-foreground-color family as the majority in every difficulty band while retaining bounded two/three-color tiles as explicit, oracle-supported extrapolation.; Moved ordinary sampling toward 4x4 and 5x5 tiles while keeping all 2x2/3x3 public forms through the profile prior. This raised 5000-draw pair uniqueness from as low as 27.8% to at least 94.62%.; Removed texture, fill_density, and noise_overlay controls whose requested values were not exactly observable in returned grids. Retained only side=2..5 and palette_size=1..3.; Constrained clean occupancy to the public-supported integer-rounded 35-75% envelope, requires background plus foreground, and guarantees every selected foreground color occurs.; Added strict validation, self_check, observe_overrides, an independent periodic rule mirror, complete-profile classification, deterministic keyed construction, fresh returns, and canonical RULE_HASH pinning.; Added ten focused regression groups and an independent 30000-draw before/after census plus 497-case live Racket parity over clean and deliberately broader oracle inputs.
summary: Let n be the input row count. Build an n-squared by n-squared output whose cell at row r and column c equals the input cell at row r modulo n and column c modulo n. Equivalently, repeat the complete n-by-n input tile n times horizontally and n times vertically, preserving every color and within-tile position.
